subject: VALUE clause
notes: kb/Work PB499, LANDED — RE-VERDICT ONLY. RE-MEASURED on this worktree's own build across ALL FIVE populations the note names, every one now giving the value the standard requires: working-storage re-initialization [AABB..], external [AABB  ] only after INITIALIZE, based [AABB  ] at ALLOCATE ... INITIALIZED, linkage [AABB..] only after INITIALIZE, file section [AABB..] only after INITIALIZE. Occurrence 3 is unspecified by the clause and is left untouched in every one, which is §14.9.20.4 GR5 c) 1. c) and GR6 a) 3. ("If the data item is a table element, the literal in the VALUE clause that corresponds to the occurrence being initialized determines the sending-operand", cite --check OK at §14.9.20.4).
